metrics.label: Our rating
metrics.unit: strokes per round v an average field
metrics.tip: Our rating: the decayed, shrunk average of a player's strokes gained, the number the forecasts use.

metrics.label: Strokes gained per round
metrics.unit: strokes per round v an average field
metrics.tip: Strokes gained per round against an average field over the window, shrunk toward the peer average.

metrics.label: Form: strokes gained, last 8 events
metrics.tip: Strokes gained per round over the player's last eight events: who is playing well now.

metrics.label: Strokes gained, rounds 1 and 2
metrics.tip: Rounds 1 and 2: before the cut, in a full field.

metrics.label: Strokes gained at the weekend
metrics.tip: Rounds 3 and 4: after the cut, usually in contention or chasing.

metrics.label: Strokes gained, front nine
metrics.tip: The front nine against the field's average front nine that day (strength-adjusted, like every number here).

metrics.label: Strokes gained, back nine
metrics.tip: The back nine, the same way. Front plus back is the round.

metrics.label: Round-to-round spread
metrics.tip: One standard deviation of the player's strokes gained from round to round, after their own average: lower is steadier.

metrics.label: Great rounds (+3 or better)
metrics.tip: Share of rounds three or more strokes better than an average field would have shot.

metrics.label: Poor rounds (-3 or worse)
metrics.tip: Share of rounds three or more strokes worse.

metrics.label: Par 3s: strokes gained per hole
metrics.tip: On par 3s, strokes better than the field on the same hole that day, per hole (hole-by-hole tours only).

metrics.label: Par 4s: strokes gained per hole
metrics.tip: On par 4s, the same way.

metrics.label: Par 5s: strokes gained per hole
metrics.tip: On par 5s, the same way: where length pays.

metrics.label: Birdie-or-better rate
metrics.tip: Share of holes played in birdie or better.

metrics.label: Bogey-or-worse rate
metrics.tip: Share of holes played in bogey or worse: lower is better.

metrics.label: Double-bogey-or-worse rate
metrics.tip: Share of holes played in double bogey or worse: the big numbers.

metrics.label: Eagle rate on par 5s
metrics.tip: Share of par 5s played in eagle or better.

metrics.label: Driving distance
metrics.tip: Average measured drive (ESPN season statistics, PGA Tour, 2017 on).

metrics.label: Driving accuracy
metrics.tip: Share of fairways hit from the tee.

metrics.label: Greens in regulation
metrics.tip: Share of greens reached in regulation (par minus two strokes).

metrics.label: Putts per green hit
metrics.tip: Putts per green reached in regulation: lower is better.

metrics.label: Sand saves
metrics.tip: Share of greenside bunker shots followed by one putt or holed out.

metrics.label: Off the tee (estimate)
metrics.tip: Our estimate from driving distance and accuracy, in strokes per round against the tour average. Not ShotLink strokes gained: a regression of our round-by-round strokes gained on season statistics.

metrics.label: Approach (estimate)
metrics.tip: Our estimate from greens in regulation, the same way.

metrics.label: Around the green (estimate)
metrics.tip: Our estimate from sand saves, the same way.

metrics.label: Putting (estimate)
metrics.tip: Our estimate from putts per green hit, the same way.

metrics.label: Win rate
metrics.tip: Wins per start, shrunk toward the peer rate (ten starts of weight).

metrics.label: Top-10 rate
metrics.tip: Top-10 finishes (ties included) per start, shrunk the same way.

metrics.label: Made-cut rate
metrics.unit: share of starts with a cut
metrics.tip: Cuts made per start in events with a cut, shrunk the same way.
